extractions.value: Patient also diagnosed with myotonic dystrophy type 2 (DM2) confirmed by genetic testing (expansion in zinc finger protein 9 gene on chromosome 3). Muscle biopsy showed only slight dystrophic changes consistent with DM2. The paper notes this is the first described case of SPS associated with DM2.
